text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Finally, it's time for the Arima Kinen, where the best runners gather. Rice Shower says she was able to become stronger thanks to Mihono Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mihono Bourbon feels the same. She learned a lot about emotions thanks to Rice Shower's unrelenting determination to keep going no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before, she never gave any thought to the intention behind a handshake, but now she's the one who extends a hand to Rice Shower.
